title: Just One More Mission
staging:
Scene 01 — Just One More Mission

00:00–01:10 · 70 sec · Resistance hideout

Establish the five cats playing Grand Theft Kitty VI on CatStation 5. Begin with an exterior view of their dilapidated building, then move inside to reveal the couch and the game.

Shots: Wide room establishing → over-the-shoulder couch → TV gameplay showing the Great Dog National Bank heist → individual reactions.
sound: Controller clicks, game gunfire, sirens, cats shouting over each other.

lines.speaker: Byte
lines.text: Left! LEFT! That is a wall, Trixie!

lines.text: My controller has input lag. I pressed jump yesterday.

lines.text: Because she keeps driving into buildings!

takes.text: Because she keeps driving into buildings!

lines.text: One more crash and somebody is going through that window.
